references.text: The same description of taking livestock and plunder from the cities after the victory over King Sihon, showing the same pattern for war spoils
The law of war spoils that allows the Israelites to take livestock and everything else in the city as plunder for themselves
The Israelites took the spoil from the Midianites, including livestock and goods, in a similar manner as described here
God allows the Israelites to take the spoil and livestock from Ai for themselves, the same principle of war spoils
The Israelites took all the spoil and livestock from the conquered cities under Joshua's leadership
